name: Beet, Orange & Spinach Salad with Goat Cheese & Chopped Walnuts
instructions: Wash, trim root ends, peel, and thinly slice beets into half rounds. Transfer to a sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast until beets are tender, 20 minutes.
Wash and dry spinach and oranges. Peel and thinly slice oranges into half rounds.
In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Crumble goat cheese into a medium bowl. Roughly chop walnuts.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with beet and orange slices. Sprinkle with goat cheese, walnuts, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
